sources.snippet: Overview stable-diffusion-v1-5 is a latent diffusion model that generates photo-realistic images from text prompts at 512×512 resolution. Maintained by benjamin-paine, this model uses a fixed pretrained CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder combined with a UNet diffusion backbone operating in the latent space of a fixed autoencoder with an 8× downsampling factor.
